title: Transfer Fcn First Order
text: Implement discrete-time first order transfer function, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Pole (in Z plane)} sets the pole, {Initial condition for previous output} and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Transfer function output signal scalar | vector

params.name: Initial condition for previous output
params.values: Initial condition for previous output 0.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
